scripts.test: fail=""; for p in packages/*/; do [ -d "$p/test" ] || continue; echo "-- $p"; (cd "$p" && bun test ./test) || fail="$fail $p"; done; [ -z "$fail" ] || { echo "FAILED:$fail" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.typecheck: for p in packages/*/; do [ -f "$p/tsconfig.test.json" ] || continue; (cd "$p" && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json) || exit 1; done
